global.label: Global
global.description: Tenant-wide baseline policies that apply to all users (block legacy auth, country blocks, terms of use).

admins.label: Admins (Privileged Roles)
admins.description: Privileged directory role holders. Should require phishing-resistant MFA, compliant device, and tight session controls.

internals.label: Internals (Employees)
internals.description: Standard internal members. MFA, compliant device, sign-in risk and user risk policies expected.

externals.label: Externals (B2B Guests)
externals.description: B2B collaboration guests and members from partner Entra tenants. MFA via auth strength (when home tenant trusts it) or basic MFA grant.

guestadmins.label: Guest Admins (External Privileged)
guestadmins.description: External admins (GDAP/CSP, partner privileged users). Require strong auth and tight session controls.

developers.label: Developers
developers.description: Higher-privilege internal developers. Often need access to dev/test tenants and tooling - requires its own MFA + compliant device set.

corpserviceaccounts.label: Corporate Service Accounts
corpserviceaccounts.description: User-mode service accounts that run automation. Should be locked to specific networks/locations and excluded from interactive MFA.

workloadidentities.label: Workload Identities
workloadidentities.description: Service principals and managed identities. Require Workload Identities Premium and CA policies targeting servicePrincipals.

microsoft365serviceaccounts.label: Microsoft 365 Service Accounts
microsoft365serviceaccounts.description: Sync accounts (Entra Connect, on-prem hybrid). Excluded from MFA but locked to known locations.

block-legacy-auth.label: Block legacy authentication
block-legacy-auth.description: Without it, older sign-in methods that cannot use multifactor authentication remain available to them.

require-mfa.label: Require multi-factor authentication
require-mfa.description: Without it, a stolen or guessed password is enough to sign in as one of them.

require-compliant-device.label: Require compliant or hybrid-joined device
require-compliant-device.description: Without it, they can sign in from any device, including unmanaged or infected ones.

sign-in-risk.label: Sign-in risk based access
sign-in-risk.description: Without it, a sign-in that Microsoft rates as suspicious goes through without any extra check.

user-risk.label: User risk based access
user-risk.description: Without it, an account that Microsoft rates as likely compromised keeps working until someone notices.

session-sif.label: Sign-in frequency / session controls
session-sif.description: Without it, a session on a shared or lost device stays valid indefinitely.

block-countries.label: Country / location block
block-countries.description: Without it, sign-ins are accepted from any country or network.

phishing-resistant-mfa.label: Phishing-resistant MFA
phishing-resistant-mfa.description: Without it, their multifactor prompt can be captured by a convincing phishing page.

block-non-corp-network.label: Restrict to corporate network / trusted locations
block-non-corp-network.description: Without it, sign-ins are accepted from outside the organization's own networks.

block-high-risk-apps.label: Block high-risk applications
block-high-risk-apps.description: Without it, applications considered too risky remain reachable.
